# harness-ledger

> harness-ledger is a Claude Code plugin that reads the session transcripts Claude Code already saves, maps the project's harness (instructions, skills, subagents, commands, hooks, settings) and suggests evidence-based changes with their costs.

Numbers (time, tokens, money) come from a local script, never from the model. Transcripts stay on the machine; links that leave it carry only shapes, names and counts. Install with `/plugin marketplace add guilhermebkel/harness-ledger`, then `/plugin install harness-ledger@guilhermebkel`, and run `/harness-ledger:audit-harness`.
